description: This course introduces the fundamentals of building backend services using the Go programming language. You will learn how to set up a Go project, understand core concepts like routing and handling HTTP requests, and ultimately answer the question: how can I make a server using Go programming language efficiently and effectively.
learning_outcomes: Understand the basics of Go for backend development.
Learn how to set up a Go development environment.
Create and configure a simple HTTP server in Go.
Implement routing and handle different HTTP methods (GET, POST).
Manage request and response data in Go applications.
Build a foundational understanding of Go's standard library for web development.
Deploy a basic Go backend application.
name: Go Backend Development Fundamentals
prerequisites: Basic understanding of programming concepts and command-line interface. No prior Go experience required.
subtitle: Build Your First Server-Side Applications with Go
targetAudience: Beginner developers interested in learning Go for backend development, students, or anyone looking to build server-side applications with a modern language.

description: Learn the fundamentals of HTML and CSS to create a professional and responsive online portfolio. This course will guide you through structuring web pages with HTML and styling them beautifully with CSS, culminating in a simple, yet effective, personal portfolio website.
learning_outcomes: Understand the basic structure of an HTML document
Utilize common HTML tags to organize content
Apply CSS rules to style HTML elements
Differentiate between inline, internal, and external CSS
Create a simple, multi-page personal portfolio website
Implement basic responsive design principles for different screen sizes
Publish a static website using common hosting methods
name: HTML and CSS for building a Simple Portfolio
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and internet navigation skills.
subtitle: Craft Your First Online Portfolio with HTML and CSS Basics
targetAudience: Absolute beginners interested in web development, aspiring designers, or anyone looking to build a simple online portfolio.
